title: fix(console): the approvals inbox status filter offers Cancelled
body:

Fixes #36960
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTDAJKyXUan6fJCKsZUf5Pv)_

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 审批收件箱「我提交的」和「全部」两个页签里，状态筛选下拉框多了「已取消」一项；以前只有五种状态，已取消的审批单在列表里看得到却筛不出来，现在可以直接筛出。
- 属于审批收件箱的体验修补：替想找"没有结论就结束了"的审批单的提交人和管理员解决翻遍整页的问题。
- 出错时最坏是筛选项显示不对，用户仍可用「全部状态」浏览；改动只在前端下拉选项，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

- The approvals inbox status select (shown on **Submitted by me** and **All**) drew five hand-typed options and had no **Cancelled**, although cancelled rows show in the same list with their own badge and the server answers `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?status=cancelled`.
- The options are now one `SelectItem` per entry of the contract's `APPROVAL_STATUSES` (`@objectstack/spec/contracts`), labelled through the page's existing `statusLabel`. Order is unchanged for the five existing statuses; Cancelled comes last. A status the contract adds later is offered without a console change; `APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS` is already `satisfies Record<ApprovalStatus, string>`, and `statusLabel` falls back to the raw token for a status it has no case for.
- The diff in `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` is confined to the option list and one import name, so it stays clear of #36979 (the tab, filter, search and sort state moving into the address) on the same file: `overlap-check.mjs` answers `merges cleanly` against both `origin/main` and #36979.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/console` patch (the published package that ships this page; `@objectstack/console` carries its built dist in the same fixed version group, the convention every console changeset follows).

**Read first (by risk):**
1. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`, the hunk inside the status `SelectContent` (the `APPROVAL_STATUSES.map` block): the one behaviour change.
2. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.statusFilterCancelled-36960.test.tsx`: the pins, with the real `approvalsApi` and a stubbed authenticated fetch.

**Two-minute check:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.statusFilterCancelled-36960.test.tsx` from the repo root (after building the `@objectstack/*` closure) answers `Tests 3 passed (3)`. In the browser: Approvals Inbox, tab **All**, open the status select: the last option is **Cancelled**, and choosing it leaves only cancelled rows.

## Tests

New file `ApprovalsInboxPage.statusFilterCancelled-36960.test.tsx`, mounting the real page over the real `approvalsApi`, with only `createAuthenticatedFetch` stubbed, so the assertion is the request URL:

- the option list is exactly `All statuses` plus one option per `APPROVAL_STATUSES` value, in contract order, with Cancelled last;
- choosing **Cancelled** sends a request-list call whose `status` query value is `cancelled`. **Red on main, green here;**
- control: choosing **Rejected** sends `status=rejected` and no `cancelled`. Green on both trees, so the Cancelled case cannot pass on a select that sends nothing or the same token for every option.

## Acceptance notes

- **Other places in this page that might omit `cancelled`: none found.** `STATUS_CLASSES` and `statusLabel` both have it. The client-side status match (`r.status !== statusFilter`) is generic. The **Pending** tab draws no status select and lists only `pending` by design. The two counts (my pending, environment pending) are pending-only by design: the contract says a cancelled request leaves the pending count. The filter's default is `all`. The `ApprovalRequestRow.status` union includes `cancelled`. #36979's address parser validates `status` against the same `APPROVAL_STATUSES`, so `?status=cancelled` will round-trip once both land.
- Observation, not filed (copy, outside the three filing classes): `statusLabel`'s English default for `returned` is "Returned for revision", while the contract's `APPROVAL_STATUS_LABELS.returned` is "Returned". The page keeps its own string. This PR leaves it unchanged.
- A new test file rather than a describe in the tombstone file: the siblings stub `approvalsApi` and read argument objects, and this pin needs the real client so it can assert the wire URL.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/console` was not run locally. It compiles against every `@object-ui/*` package's built `dist/*.d.ts`, which this worktree does not have. `Type Check UI` in CI covers it. The test file was linted locally (0 errors, 0 warnings).
